svg.title: A pile of bleached driftwood on a river gravel bar: seven barkless spars of different lengths and thicknesses lying ACROSS one another at seven different angles, none parallel, none stood up or leaned, none steeper than twenty degrees, among rounded cobbles. EVERY SPAR IS A BOWED CAPSULE WITH ROUNDED ENDS, AND THAT IS THE CORRECTION THIS BUILD EXISTS FOR. A blind pass read the previous build as a stack of freshly milled squared lumber in a sawmill yard, and it was right to: those pieces had straight parallel sides, sharp corners and flat darker end faces, which is what a sawn baulk is, and the slanted end wedges an earlier build had added to escape that reading only made the faces look more sawn. There is no flat end anywhere now and there cannot be: every spar is drawn as a ROUND-CAPPED STROKE along a bent centreline, so each terminus is a half-disc of the log's own body tone. The taper is three concentric round-capped strokes narrowing toward the tip, so the spar thins like a trunk without ever ending in a whittled point. The darker end each `mustBeRight` asks for is a short round dab on the SHADED UNDERSIDE of the cap - the shadow under a worn end - and never a face across it. The root wad is a lumpy asymmetric mass with four roots of four lengths and thicknesses on ONE side; the earlier one had a near-circular knob with a concentric highlight and read as a circular saw blade, and nothing round-and-concentric remains. Bodies run across the pale ends of the `limestone`, `stone` and `path` ramps so the pile carries sun-bleached warmth rather than one flat grey card. No bark, no green wood, no cut, no tool mark, no point. Natural debris and nothing else: no cairn, no inuksuk, no marker, no structure, no shelter, no fish weir and no figure at any scale - assets/style/the-north-level.md and docs/content-review.md. Drawn from the driftwood along the shore in assets/refs/the-north/yukon-river-bluff-and-aspen.jpg and the bars in yukon-river-valley.jpg; see assets/refs/references.json, subject driftwood-pile. POI hero, present at every visual tier.
